name: orosy-mcp
display_name: orosy (wholesale marketplace) + orosy Buyer API MCP
description: orosy (wholesale marketplace) + orosy Buyer API (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_produc

platform_mcp_orosy_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_OROSY_API_KEY
platform_mcp_orosy_api_key.description: orosy Buyer API key (orosy_live_…) issued in the portal after the business review (事業者確認), sent as `Authorization: Bearer` ('OAuth 不要'). Before approval the account works in test mode on demo data.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v1/me: {email, company_name, approved (review state), country, default_ship_to_country, buyer_registered}.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /v1/products: keyword search over product name, brand, model number, category and variation names (space-separated words are ANDed; 8-13 digits search JAN codes). Product data is Japanese, so search with Japanese keywords. `price` is the lowest variation's wholesale price (税抜, yen); `category` must be a category UUID (from product details or GET /v1/delivery-groups/{group_code}/categories); orderable=false rows are display-only.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /v1/products/{product_id} (UUID): variations[{variation_id, jan, variant_label, buyer_price (wholesale, tax-excluded yen), retail_price, order_unit (order in multiples), stock_level, stock_qty}] plus the delivery group's fee, free-shipping threshold and minimum order amount. The mapped price/stock/currency are those of the first variation; see raw.variations for the rest.

tools.name: quote_shipping
tools.description: GET /v1/cross-border/eligibility?dest=&product_ids=: per product, whether it can ship to that country (logistics / compliance status) and a REFERENCE international shipping fee (shipping.status quoted | quote_required | unavailable; amount in yen, tax-excluded). The fee is only an estimate (the actual cost is billed later); `quantity` is not used by this endpoint (GET /v1/cross-border/cart-estimate prices the cart). Domestic (JP) delivery fees come from the product's delivery group.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /v1/orders/{order_id}: status (fulfilment axis, e.g. pending_confirmation, confirmed, partially_confirmed, cancelled, payment_action_required), breakdown.total (tax-included amount billed), payment.status, and per delivery group groups[].shipments[].trackings[] (tracking_number is the first one). 'There is no dedicated shipment API' — tracking lives in this order detail.

tools.name: track
tools.description: The shipments of the order's FIRST delivery group (groups[0].shipments[]: status preparing | shipped | delivered | returned, trackings[{tracking_no, carrier}], shipped_at, delivered_at). Orders spanning several delivery groups have more shipments under groups[1..] — read them with get_order (raw.groups).
